status: Shared shaped-text lookup indexed in every default renderer; GPI-S2 remains in progress
change: A sorted (shaping fingerprint, entry index) vector narrows candidates before the existing exact key comparison. Hash collisions never establish identity. Extent remains a layout dependency within the same shaping bucket, preserving extent-only relayout reuse. Rebuild the metadata after eviction/reordering and release obsolete capacity. No key text or Buffer payload is duplicated by the index.
competing_paths_retired: Scanning every retained shaped buffer for each label on the default workspace/terminal/dialog paths
remaining_competing_paths: Current shaping/layout keys, profiles, glyph preparation and static text width owner remain unchanged. Complete configurable-key/resource qualification stays open.

bounds.owner: Same TextBufferCache lifetime as shaped buffers; renderer replacement/closure drops it
bounds.entries: Exactly one (u64, usize) tuple per live cache entry
bounds.retained_capacity: After eviction/reordering, at most four times live entry count; empty releases all index capacity. Dialog post-frame 128-entry cap therefore bounds index capacity to 512 tuple slots (8192 bytes on this 64-bit target). Workspace follows its existing two generations/current visible text; no absolute workspace payload cap is newly claimed.
bounds.proof: 160-row fixture trims to 128 retained rows with 2560 metadata-capacity bytes; subsequent workspace retirement shrinks to one entry and then zero capacity. This metadata accounting excludes shaped payload/atlas, which remain separately unqualified.

proof.lookup: 160 distinct warm labels need 160 exact comparisons. Disabling candidate narrowing performs 12880 and fails the operation-count assertion. This is a work-count proof, not native wall-time performance acceptance.
proof.identity: Injected colliding fingerprints still select the exact existing key. Omitting exact comparison fails the collision assertion. Existing text/size/face/rich style/extent and placement-only tests pass.
proof.retirement: Actual recency reordering, overlay cap, index rebasing and workspace two-generation retirement preserve hits and release index peak capacity.
proof.renderer: 201 passed, 20 ignored on restored source; final focused owner tests cover the recency reorder extension.
proof.gpu: Explicit Intel P630/Vulkan fractional dialog scroll, cached relayout/fresh-pixel parity and shared-atlas retry/cache-reindex proofs pass.
proof.lint_build_native: Renderer library/tests visual-feature Clippy and fresh offline release pass. All four native X11 host smokes pass, including Main wheel input. Initial test-only cloned-reference Clippy failure retained and corrected.
proof.governance: Source health, dependency authority, evidence traceability, parity, spec/project checks and staged formatting checked before commit. No ceiling or dependency change. Existing unrelated terminal convergence drift remains open; full drift not rerun.

limits: The index accelerates lookup; it does not complete configurable font/language/features keys, shaped allocation accounting, atlas bounds or full REUSE-TEXT-KEY qualification.

Collision buckets and multiple extents still require exact comparison. Cold insertion shifts sorted metadata, and eviction/reordering rebuilds it; no zero-total-work or numerical application speedup claim.
Full per-adapter counters, native backend/scale/endurance/resource qualification and S2 completion remain open.
No dependency, vendoring, Cargo, visual-prototype, product-authority, rendering schedule or resize qualification change.
